verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right banner: the quote, attribution and quote mark share a left edge, and the circle is cropped off the edge as in the original. But the quote text is small for the format, the logo is tiny and indented off the text edge, floating above dead space, and the can sits off-centre toward the top-left of the circle. B gives the quote better size, but there is a big gap between the quote mark and the quote. The attribution wraps to two lines and is jammed into a row with an oversized logo that competes with it. The can sits in the top half of a fully enclosed circle, leaving the lower half empty, so the composition feels less intentional.
